mapProfile.thesis: Survive sustained attrition while rebuilding water, food, repair, and rest stops along the canals.
bossPrepHints: Bank Cohesion at Basins before the Canal Gatekeeper's drowning pressure.
Carry Scrap into the final Market; the boss punishes a starved economy.
Keep Open Sky Guard for the heron's sweeping reach.

enemies.name: Dock Warden
enemies.lesson: Elite: a lock-keeper bruiser that guards, then rams.
enemies.description: A broad canal coot that controls the dock gate and turns every crossing into a shove match.
enemies.visualBrief: Stocky black coot in a reinforced rain shell, rubberized talon bands, lock-chain clips, and a wet utility harness beside canal gates and warning buoys.
enemies.silhouette: Compact heavy waterbird with a forward shield-like chest and low guard stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Dock Rat
enemies.lesson: Chip damage adds up; spend Cover before it stacks.
enemies.description: A canal rat that nips from between crates and turns small mistakes into steady attrition.
enemies.visualBrief: Damp brown rat in a tiny patched slicker, paw wraps, rope-belt harness, and bead-like rain drops on dock planks beside market crates.
enemies.silhouette: Small low runner with wet fur spikes, thin tail, and quick jaw-forward pose.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural limbs, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Market Crow
enemies.lesson: Scavengers heal if left alone; deny their rest turn.
enemies.description: A market crow that steals, sorts, and recovers behind the bustle whenever the flock looks away.
enemies.visualBrief: Glossy crow in a cropped market-worker jacket, bright abstract pin clips, tiny satchel, and talon bands amid tarps, produce crates, and canal reflections.
enemies.silhouette: Medium corvid with hunched shoulders, bright eye, and lifted scavenger beak.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Dredge Eel
enemies.lesson: Winded throttles your tempo; plan around the lull.
enemies.description: A slick canal eel that coils around dredge ropes and slows the flock with wet, dragging pressure.
enemies.visualBrief: Long eel with a flexible waterproof strap harness, reflective canal tags, and cord loops sliding through muddy water beside dredge gear and algae nets.
enemies.silhouette: Long sinuous body forming a low coil with a sharp raised head.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, coil angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears coiled, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body shape visible with natural fins and tail, resting on an implied ground line or waterline with weight supported by its natural body; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human posture.

enemies.name: Barge Gull
enemies.lesson: Heavy Strike rewards Cover banked in advance.
enemies.description: A barge gull that rides canal thermals, waits for a gap, and crashes down with dockside force.
enemies.visualBrief: Large gull in a loose canal-worker wind shell, cargo strap, bright talon bands, and rain-specked feathers over a barge rail and rope piles.
enemies.silhouette: Wide gliding bird with long wings, dropped head, and diving diagonal read.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Lock Keeper
enemies.lesson: A turtling foe stalls your clock; out-pace its Cover.
enemies.description: A patient moorhen lock keeper that hides behind the canal works and lets the water do half the fighting.
enemies.visualBrief: Dark moorhen in a hooded rain wrap, tiny key clips without readable marks, webbed-foot bands, and a compact utility pouch near a steel lock wheel.
enemies.silhouette: Round guarded waterbird tucked behind a vertical gate shape.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Ferry Cormorant
enemies.lesson: Optional elite that grinds you down between Basins.
enemies.description: A canal cormorant ferryman that rows the route his way and punishes flocks that arrive tired.
enemies.visualBrief: Long-necked black cormorant in a slate rain shell, reflective teal sash, oar-strap harness, waterproof pouch, and orange webbed-foot bands on a narrow ferry deck in gray canal light.
enemies.silhouette: Tall waterbird with a hooked beak, folded wet wings, long neck, oar diagonal, and broad webbed-foot stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and webbed feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Toll Magpie
enemies.lesson: Punishes a low Scrap economy by forcing Snags.
enemies.description: A toll magpie that knows every shortcut price and turns unpaid routes into tangles.
enemies.visualBrief: Black-and-white magpie in a sharp cropped rain jacket, shiny coin clips, sling pouch, and talon bands with toll-rail rope and wet-tag styling.
enemies.silhouette: Sleek long-tailed bird with a tilted bargaining posture and bright scavenger accents.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, long tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: The Canal Gatekeeper
enemies.description: A towering heron that holds the canal's central gate and tests whether the flock can survive slow water pressure.
enemies.visualBrief: Tall great heron in layered canal rainwear, long hooded neck wrap, reflective leg bands, and a basin-worker satchel standing amid raised weirs and churning locks.
enemies.silhouette: Very tall spear-necked waterbird with long legs and a still, gate-like stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, long neck, legs, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Canal Otter
enemies.lesson: Water flanker: chips, shifts tempo, and rewards quick focus.
enemies.description: A slick canal runner that slides through wet lanes and appears where the flock thought the crossing was safe.
enemies.visualBrief: Streamlined otter in a fitted waterproof shell, clipped pouch harness, and close neck scarf on wet dock planks near lock water and rope coils.
enemies.silhouette: Long low body, tapered head, thick tail, and slippery side-on movement read.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched low on natural paws with long tail visible and rainwear tight to the body.

enemies.name: Crab Dockguard
enemies.lesson: Dockguard tank: remove Cover before the dock lane locks down.
enemies.description: A dock crab that patrols sideways under mooring lines and makes narrow crossings awkward.
enemies.visualBrief: Crab with painted shell decals, cargo strap around the shell, tiny waterproof pouches, and natural claws free on wet pier boards.
enemies.silhouette: Wide low crustacean with big claws, shell rectangle, and sideways stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, weight on natural legs with claws visible and shell straps not becoming armor.

enemies.name: Frog Canal Jumper
enemies.lesson: Leaper: alternates small hits with Winded tempo pressure.
enemies.description: A bright canal frog that springs over clutter and splashes the flock out of clean formation.
enemies.visualBrief: Green frog in a short waterproof hood cape, flexible leg bands, and tiny belly-safe pouch beside puddles and algae-slick stone.
enemies.silhouette: Compact amphibian with large back legs, wide head, and ready-to-hop crouch.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched on natural limbs with leg bands flexing freely and no sleeves.

enemies.name: Turtle Barricader
enemies.lesson: Slow barricade: break Cover before the canal lane locks down.
enemies.description: A stubborn canal turtle that turns dock clutter into a living roadblock while escorts work around it.
enemies.visualBrief: Pond turtle with shell-safe stickered cargo netting, small waterproof pouches, and strap clips that do not cover the legs or alter the shell.
enemies.silhouette: Low dome shell, short planted legs, blunt head, and wide immovable base.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, shell and natural legs fully visible, resting on an implied ground line with no fake armor silhouette.

enemies.name: Cormorant Netter
enemies.lesson: Control netter: dock-line Snags and Winded turns tax slow hands.
enemies.description: A wet-winged canal netter that turns loose dock line into dragged, physical control.
enemies.visualBrief: Cormorant in a slate rain shell, oar-strap harness, dock-line loops clipped to body, and orange webbed-foot bands.
enemies.silhouette: Long-neck black waterbird with hooked beak, folded wet wings, and webbed-foot stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on webbed feet with lines clipped to harness, never held by invented hands.

enemies.name: Kingfisher Snapdiver
enemies.lesson: Water assassin: Open Sky setup into a burst dive if the flock stays exposed.
enemies.description: A sharp canal kingfisher that waits above the waterline and strikes exactly when the flock drifts.
enemies.visualBrief: Belted kingfisher in a close rain collar, tiny waterproof side pouch, and talon bands beside low canal posts and rippled water.
enemies.silhouette: Compact crested bird with large head, dagger beak, short tail, and taut crouch.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on talons with wings folded and beak aligned to the body angle.

enemies.name: Heron Spearstepper
enemies.lesson: Reach elite: long telegraphs combine Winded, Cover, and Open Sky punishment.
enemies.description: A still canal hunter that threatens from the edge of the water with patient, precise reach.
enemies.visualBrief: Tall heron in a tailored waterproof sash, pinned-close scarf, reflective leg bands, and small dock satchel beside a canal rail.
enemies.silhouette: Very tall spear-neck waterbird with long legs, narrow head, and patient vertical stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, weight on natural long legs with neck folded in a heron S-curve and clothing clear of leg motion.

enemies.name: Opossum Decoy
enemies.lesson: Feint controller: ignored turns let it rebuild tempo before a startle snap.
enemies.description: A theatrical canal-market survivor that slumps beside curb stalls, watches through patched scarf layers, and snaps when the flock commits wrong.
enemies.visualBrief: Opossum in layered vintage scarf wraps, patched denim-like back cloth, tiny charm clips, close paw bands, and canal-market curb salvage with tail fully free.
enemies.silhouette: Low marsupial with pointed snout, arched back, long bare tail, and sly half-collapsed pose.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, crouched naturally with decoy tension rather than a human acting pose.

enemies.name: Goose Bouncer
enemies.lesson: Space-control charger: loud lane denial into a heavy body check.
enemies.description: A canal-side bouncer that owns the crossing and forces the flock to respect its lane.
enemies.visualBrief: Canada goose in a varsity-style chest bib, bold color blocking, wing-safe bands, and dockside rain grit.
enemies.silhouette: Large long-neck bird with broad body, webbed feet, and aggressive forward lean.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, planted on natural webbed feet with neck thrust but body balanced.

enemies.name: Mantis Street Duelist
enemies.lesson: Precision elite: read, guard, then punish sloppy timing with clean cuts.
enemies.description: A poised mantis that reads the flock's rhythm and answers sloppy timing with clean precision.
enemies.visualBrief: Large mantis in sleek segmented wrap accents and a tiny thorax panel, limbs fully exposed, perched on cracked market tile.
enemies.silhouette: Tall insect with triangular head, folded raptorial forelegs, and needle-thin stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, balanced on natural insect legs with wraps following body segments and no humanoid jacket shape.

signals.title: Flooded Pantry
signals.prompt: A market stall is half underwater, but salvageable seed and clean water sit just out of reach in the current.

signals.title: Lockmaster's Ledger
signals.prompt: An abandoned ledger maps the canal locks. Tracing it could open a shortcut, but the ink runs in the damp.

signals.title: Tide Shelter
signals.prompt: A dry repair berth offers rest, but a tidewatcher warns the next stretch runs under open canal sky.

signals.title: Wingfeather Broker
signals.prompt: A grizzled lock broker hawks salvaged flight feathers and quill repairs. The best stock goes fast — and costs.

choices.text: Trade the whole deal for supplies.

signals.title: Bilgewater Cargo
signals.prompt: A sinking barge spills crates of scrap into the canal. Grab what you can — but the bilge reeks of rot and tangle.

signals.title: Ferry Toll Gamble
signals.prompt: The ferry master offers a wager: a fat purse by sunset, but the fog and toll always take their cut.

signals.title: Woven Trap
signals.prompt: A section of canal ahead is choked with logjams and algae nets. The detour is clear but adds pressure. You could try to cut through.

signals.title: Salvage Net
signals.prompt: A repair crew's lost net bobs in the shallows, tangled with useful cord, patches, and signal flares.

choices.text: Leave it for the next crew.

signals.title: Stray Gosling
signals.prompt: A lost gosling has tangled itself in your flock's formation — darling but a liability. The lock keeper points to a safer route if you cut it loose.
